definitions.gloss: procedure manual; instruction document; step-by-step guide
definitions.explanation: A document that describes the steps to be followed to complete a task or process. Common in workplaces, technical fields, and quality management.

examples.japanese: {手順書|てじゅんしょ}に{従|したが}って{作業|さぎょう}する。
examples.english: To work according to the procedure manual.

examples.japanese: {手順書|てじゅんしょ}を{作成|さくせい}してください。
{手順書|てじゅんしょ}が{古|ふる}くなっていたので、{最新|さいしん}の{内容|ないよう}に{更新|こうしん}した。
examples.english: The procedure manual was outdated, so I updated it with the latest information.

notes:
Compound of {手順|てじゅん} (procedure, steps) and {書|しょ} (document, writing). A standard workplace term for written instructions that ensure tasks are performed consistently and correctly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手順書|てじゅんしょ}を{作成|さくせい}する — to create a procedure manual
- {手順書|てじゅんしょ}に{従|したが}う — to follow the procedure manual
- {手順書|てじゅんしょ}を{更新|こうしん}する — to update the procedure manual
- {手順書|てじゅんしょ}{通|どお}りに — as written in the procedure manual
- {作業|さぎょう}{手順書|てじゅんしょ} — work procedure document

SIMILAR WORDS:
- マニュアル — manual; broader term, can include non-procedural content
- {説明書|せつめいしょ} — instruction manual; usually for products, not work processes
- {取扱説明書|とりあつかいせつめいしょ} — user manual; operation manual (for equipment)
- {仕様書|しようしょ} — specification document; describes requirements, not steps
